proposed.text: Using the '2 Hundred, 20 People' memory aid under PD 1096 Rule XII, Sec. 1212, which of the following correctly states the dual trigger for fire-extinguishing systems in habitation areas?

options.text: ≥ 200 sq.m AND > 20 occupants, with the system required only on the floor where both thresholds are exceeded

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: This is the most frequently tested trap in Section 1212. The asymmetric threshold (≥ for area, > for occupants) is intentional and testable. A 200 sq.m office with exactly 20 occupants does NOT trigger the requirement.
